3. HUB LIMITS: the hub is shared; the T3 service has 8 CPUs / 49 GiB with Maxim's Unity builds and our game bots running now. ONE heavy python at a time; before each: python3 export/hub_guard.py --need-gb 6 --wait 1800 --quiet; prefix nice -n 10; long runs via Bash run_in_background with an explicit timeout (<= 7200000 ms). Never write outside the project; do not commit; do not edit game files (*.gd, scenes).
Write .orchestra/tasks/62/feel2/argon/verify/stage.md: a table region x check (base vs merged), timings, merge findings, verdict (merge OK to commit or not, and why). Return the same as text.
